lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਲਤਣਿ ਭੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੇਕੈ ਪਾਧਰ ਹੀਡੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bholatan bhai man vasai hekai paadhar heed ||
lines.translation: The Fear of God abides in the mind of the innocent; this is the straight path to the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਡਾਹਪਣਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਤੀਨੇ ਥਾਵ ਭਰੀਡੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: at daahapan dukh ghano teene thaav bhareed ||1||
lines.translation: Jealousy and envy bring terrible pain, and one is cursed throughout the three worlds. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਦਲੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਸਿ ਬਾਜਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਧੜੀਐ ਜੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maa(n)dal bed s baajano ghano dhaReeai joi ||
lines.translation: The drum of the Vedas vibrates, bringing dispute and divisiveness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal too beejau avar na koi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; there is none except Him. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਹਾਥਾਲਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagar gunee athaahu kin haathaalaa dekheeai ||
lines.translation: The world-ocean of the three qualities is unfathomably deep; how can its bottom be seen?

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa veparavaahu satigur milai ta paar pavaa ||
lines.translation: If I meet with the great, self-sufficient True Guru, then I am carried across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਝ ਭਰਿ ਦੁਖ ਬਦੁਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: majh bhar dukh badukh ||
lines.translation: This ocean is filled up with pain and suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ ਭੁਖ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's hunger is appeased. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee a(n)dar bhaaliaa gur sabad suhaavai ||
lines.translation: Those who search their inner beings, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are exalted and adorned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਨਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ichhan so paaide har naam dhiaavai ||
lines.translation: They obtain what they wish for, meditating on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kripaa kare tis gur milai so har gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by God's Grace, meets with the Guru; he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai tin kaa mit hai jam mag na paavai ||
lines.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is his friend; he does not have to walk on the Path of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: har naam dhiaavahi dinas raat har naam samaavai ||14||
lines.translation: He meditates on the Lord's Name, day and night; he is absorbed and immersed in the Lord's Name. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਮਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: suneeai ek vakhaaneeai surag mirat paiaal ||
lines.translation: Listen to and speak the Name of the One Lord, who permeates the heavens, this world and the nether regions of the underworld.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaaee metiaa jo likhiaa so naal ||
lines.translation: The Hukam of His Command cannot be erased; whatever He has written, shall go with the mortal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun mooaa kaun maarasee kaun aavai kaun jaai ||
lines.translation: Who has died, and who kills? Who comes and who goes?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਰਹਸੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaun rahasee naanakaa kis kee surat samaai ||1||
lines.translation: Who is enraptured, O Nanak, and whose consciousness merges in the Lord? ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੁਆ ਮੈ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau muaa mai maariaa paun vahai dareeaau ||
lines.translation: In egotism, he dies; possessiveness kills him, and the breath flows out like a river.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਥਕੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa thakee naanakaa jaa man rataa naai ||
lines.translation: Desire is exhausted, O Nanak, only when the mind is imbued with the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਰਤੇ ਲੋਇਣੀ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: loin rate loinee ka(n)nee surat samaai ||
lines.translation: His eyes are imbued with the eyes of the Lord, and his ears ring with celestial consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਚੂਨੜੀ ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਲਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeebh rasaain choonaRee ratee laal lavaai ||
lines.translation: His tongue drinks in the sweet nectar, dyed crimson by chanting the Name of the Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਮੁਸਕਿ ਝਕੋਲਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar musak jhakoliaa keemat kahee na jaai ||2||
lines.translation: His inner being is drenched with the Lord's fragrance; his worth cannot be described. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jug mahi naam nidhaan hai naamo naal chalai ||
lines.translation: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure. Only the Naam goes along in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿਉ ਪਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu akhut kade na nikhutaee khaai kharachiu palai ||
lines.translation: It is inexhaustible; it is never empty, no matter how much one may eat, consume or spend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਜਮਕਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan neR na aavaee jamaka(n)kar jamakalai ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the humble servant of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: se saah sache vanajaariaa jin har dhan palai ||
lines.translation: They alone are the true bankers and traders, who have the wealth of the Lord in their laps.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਘਲੈ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: har kirapaa te har paaeeai jaa aap har ghalai ||15||
lines.translation: By the Lord's Mercy, one finds the Lord, only when the Lord Himself sends for him. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਾਪਾਰੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਖ ਸਿਉ ਧਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh vaapaarai saar na jaananee bikh vihaajhahi bikh sa(n)grahahi bikh siu dharahi piaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the excellence of trading in Truth. He deals in poison, collects poison, and is in love with poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: baaharahu pa(n)dit sadaaide manahu moorakh gaavaar ||
lines.translation: Outwardly, they call themselves Pandits, religious scholars, but in their minds they are foolish and ignorant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਨੀ ਵਾਦੀ ਧਰਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siu chit na laainee vaadee dharan piaar ||
lines.translation: They do not focus their consciousness on the Lord; they love to engage in arguments.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਦਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨਿ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaadaa keeaa karan kahaaneeaa kooR bol karahi aahaar ||
lines.translation: They speak to cause arguments, and earn their living by telling lies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag mahi raam naam har niramalaa hor mailaa sabh aakaar ||
lines.translation: In this world, only the Lord's Name is immaculate and pure. All other objects of creation are polluted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na chetanee hoi maile marahi gavaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are polluted; they die in ignorance. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh lagaa bin seviai hukam ma(n)ne dukh jaai ||
lines.translation: Without serving the Lord, he suffers in pain; accepting the Hukam of God's Command, pain is gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੁਖੈ ਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape daataa sukhai daa aape dei sajaai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Giver of peace; He Himself awards punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai sabh kichh tisai rajaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, know this well; all that happens is according to His Will. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam binaa jagat hai niradhan bin naavai tripat naahee ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, the world is poor. Without the Name, no one is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bharam bhulaaiaa haumai dukh paahee ||
lines.translation: He is deluded by duality and doubt. In egotism, he suffers in pain.
